description: Detailed QFT subfield convention configuration — the default reference for physics convention locks

natural_units.description: ℏ = c = 1. All quantities expressed in powers of energy. Mass in GeV, length in GeV⁻¹, time in GeV⁻¹.

metric_signature.description: g_μν = diag(+1, -1, -1, -1). Timelike vectors have positive norm. Used in Peskin & Schroeder, Weinberg QFT.

consequences.kinetic_term: Positive kinetic energy: ∂_μ φ ∂^μ φ has correct sign
consequences.on_shell_condition: p² = p_μ p^μ = m² > 0 for timelike

fourier_convention.description: Forward: f̃(k) = ∫ d⁴x f(x) exp(+ik·x). Inverse: f(x) = ∫ d⁴k/(2π)⁴ f̃(k) exp(-ik·x). The 2π factors all in the inverse transform.

renormalization_scheme.description: Renormalization conditions imposed at physical particle masses. Propagator pole at physical mass with residue 1. Used in Peskin & Schroeder Chapter 10.

consequences.pole_condition: Propagator pole at p² = m²_ph (physical mass)
consequences.counterterms: Defined to cancel divergences at physical mass point
consequences.running: Parameters run with scale μ via RG equations

renormalization_scheme.conversion_to_MS_bar: m_OS² = m_MS_bar²(μ) [1 + δm²/m² + ...] where δ includes finite shift

gauge_choice.description: ∂_μ A^μ = 0 gauge fixing. Propagator: D_μν(k) = -i(g_μν - k_μ k_ν/k²)/(k²+iε) + gauge terms. ξ parameter in general Lorentz gauge.

coordinate_system.description: Flat spacetime with Cartesian coordinates. ds² = dt² - dx² - dy² - dz² (mostly-minus).

spin_statistics.description: Integer spin → commutation relations → Bose-Einstein statistics. Half-integer spin → anticommutation relations → Fermi-Dirac statistics.

consequences.fermion_partition: Z_F = 1 + exp(-βE) for single fermion mode
consequences.field_commutation: [φ(x), φ(y)] = iΔ(x-y) for scalar; {ψ(x), ψ̄(y)} = iS(x-y) for spinor

lagrangian_sign.description: Lagrangian L = T - V with positive kinetic energy term. Standard convention in most QFT textbooks.

mostly_minus_to_mostly_plus.description: To convert results from mostly-minus to mostly-plus signature
transformations: γ matrices: γ^μ → same but contraction sign flips

natural_to_SI.description: To convert from natural units (ℏ=c=1) to SI
transformations: Restore ℏ, c factors by dimensional analysis

physics_to_math_fourier.description: To convert between physics and mathematical Fourier conventions
transformations: Physics → Math: multiply forward transform by (2π)^(d/2)
Math → Physics: divide forward transform by (2π)^(d/2)
Math: 2π split symmetrically between forward and inverse

on_shell_to_MS_bar.description: To convert between on-shell and MS-bar renormalization schemes
transformations: Finite parts differ; divergent parts same (both cancel poles)
